channel.title: John DeWitt on Anti-Federalist Library
channel.description: Recent content in John DeWitt on Anti-Federalist Library

item.title: John DeWitt I
item.description: Urges citizens to cautiously and rationally examine the proposed Constitution before ratification, warning that its sweeping powers demand scrutiny, not blind acceptance based on reputation or promises of prosperity.

item.title: John DeWitt II
item.description: Advises citizens to reject the Constitution’s permanence and centralization unless they fully accept its vast powers, warning that true amendments will be nearly impossible and rights remain unprotected without a Bill of Rights.

item.title: John DeWitt III
item.description: Criticizes the proposed Constitution as a deceptive structure designed to empower an aristocratic elite, stripping true representation from the people and placing unchecked authority in the hands of distant, unaccountable officials.
